calibration_boundary.center_free_rank16_component_proposal_re: exact withheld component occurs uniquely in 4/4 ledgers
calibration_boundary.equal_weight_rank16_component_selection: recovers the particular withheld component in 2/4 controls
calibration_boundary.fermigier_dimension_persistence: selects dimension 12 at both declared cutoffs
calibration_boundary.interpretation: The target run is exploratory and fail-closed. Component-selection calibration is not a theorem and is not strong enough for a provenance claim by itself.

cloud_protocol.adaptive_bound_rule: choose the first bound with at least 1800 rays; reject the fibre if none occurs before bound 80 or if enumeration reaches 100000 rays
cloud_protocol.population: full displayed independent subgroup; primitive unoriented short rays

component_protocol.distance_normalization: empirical lower-is-better percentile separately for every fibre pair/channel
component_protocol.post_prune_objective: maximize exact held-out replayed rays per total candidate rank
structural_channels: primitive Hermite signature after exact saturation

cross_validation_protocol.dimension_acceptance: one k must recur in at least four independent fibre scans
cross_validation_protocol.folds: all five choices of one held-out fibre
cross_validation_protocol.held_out_prediction: select the held-out component using training structural signatures and development finite blocks only; evaluate global held-out rays and validation finite blocks afterward
cross_validation_protocol.strong_signal: the same k and compatible component embeddings pass at least four folds, including successful prediction in each corresponding untouched fibre
cross_validation_protocol.training_acceptance: a compatible primitive component bundle must occur in all four training fibres

dimension_protocol.score: for k, take the minimum integrality-LLR over k-1,k,k+1 at every persistence cutoff; maximize this cross-cutoff bottleneck, then the k score, then prefer smaller k

finite_protocol.block_rule: for each relation prime, first three usable one-dimensional quotient blocks are development and next three are validation; reduction-prime identities and quotient bases are forgotten in cross-fibre signatures

forbidden_under_tag: changing a parameter after inspecting any target outcome
no_tuning_rule: After this manifest is written, no target observation may change a bound, seed, threshold, channel weight, score ordering, dimension rule, parent/component pool, finite-prime policy, or hold-out rule under this algorithm tag. A changed method requires a new tag and remains invalid as confirmation on these five records.
proof_boundary: The manifest freezes a bounded experimental algorithm, not a lattice-existence theorem. Exact arithmetic subroutines remain exact within their declared clouds; height selection, dimension persistence, component sampling, structural distances, and cutoffs are heuristic.
